subject.statement: Do Kwon is currently in custody in Montenegro.

summary: As of late 2024, Do Kwon had been extradited from Montenegro to South Korea after Montenegrin courts upheld the extradition request, and there have been no credible reports of him remaining in Montenegrin custody through 2026.
